seo.title: Virtual reception
seo.seo_title: AI virtual reception, day and night
seo.seo_description: A virtual reception that answers calls, emails and text messages, books appointments and transfers to the right person, in French and English, day and night.

blocks.role: Promesse : chaque demande reçoit une réponse ; trois canaux, deux langues.

translation.headline: Every call gets an answer.
translation.subheadline: A virtual reception answers your calls, emails and text messages, day and night, in French and English. It books appointments, qualifies requests, transfers to the right person and summarizes every exchange.

blocks.role: Aperçu : trois canaux au même endroit, la maquette en vis-à-vis.

translation.title: One reception, three channels.
translation.body:
Phone calls, emails and text messages arrive in one place. The virtual reception understands the request, answers with your information (hours, services, policies) and acts: it adds the appointment to your calendar, updates your customer management tool or passes the call to the right person.

Every exchange ends with a written summary, sent to whoever you choose.
translation.media_alt: A front desk where the voice answers, takes notes and passes things on.

cards.title: Answer calls.
cards.text: It picks up, understands the request and answers with your information. It routes the call to the right person when needed.

cards.title: Answer emails.
cards.text: It reads incoming emails, answers common questions and sends the follow-up messages you have planned.

cards.title: Answer text messages.
cards.text: Appointment confirmation, arrival time, quick question: the answer goes out by text.

cards.title: Book appointments.
cards.text: It checks your calendar, offers open slots and books the appointment; a reminder can go out the day before.

cards.title: Qualify and transfer.
cards.text: It asks the right questions, recognizes an emergency and transfers to the right person, with the context.

cards.title: Summarize every exchange.
cards.text: A clear summary after every call, email or text: who, what, what was done and what is left to do.

blocks.role: Connexions et contrôle : ligne, règles, données.

translation.title: Connected to your systems.
translation.body: The virtual reception connects to what you already use: your phone line, your email, your calendar and your customer management tool. Possible connections are checked during the consultation, system by system.

items.title: Your line.
items.text: Your number stays yours; the reception takes calls according to the rules you set: hours, overflow, night.

items.title: Your rules.
items.text: What it may say, what it must transfer, who to reach in an emergency: you decide, in writing.

items.title: Your data.
items.text: Exchanges and summaries stay at your site or on our servers, depending on the mode you choose.

cards.title: Consultation.
cards.text: We listen to your typical requests, your rules and your tools. You receive a written proposal.

cards.title: Installation.
cards.text: We configure the reception, its answers and its connections, then put it to the test with you on real cases.

cards.title: Operation.
cards.text: We monitor the quality of exchanges, adjust the answers and stay reachable.

items.question: Do callers know they are talking to an AI?
items.answer: Yes. The reception introduces itself as your company's virtual assistant, and callers can always ask to speak to a person.

items.question: What happens if it does not know the answer?
items.answer: It says so, takes the contact details and transfers the request to the right person, with a summary. It does not make things up: its answers come from the information you give it.

items.question: Does it work in French and English?
items.answer: Yes. It answers in the language of the person calling or writing.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: There is no public price yet. Two things are paid for: our services (a written estimate follows the consultation) and platform usage, in credits. Prices will appear on the Pricing page as soon as they are published.

translation.title: Hear it answer.
translation.text: We prepare a demonstration with your most frequent questions, then we talk about your line, your tools and your rules.
